messages:
marta: Heads up — planning a targeted recompute for cohort_signals (2026-03-10..2026-03-15). This is a signal-led backfill: only users with signal_delta > 0. Need routing/quota + console UX sanity check before we kick off.

raj: Quick q — is this full-window or incremental? how big is the cohort?

marta: incremental. expected ~120k unique users, ~35M events. We want to prioritize high-signal cohorts first (top 10%).

sam: For throughput: prefer dedicated priority lane to avoid impacting hosted API SLAs. We can route via the replay-priority pool and cap concurrency to 48 slots.

lydia: On the console side, can we add a transient "recompute job" tile under Telemetry > Backfills with live progress and projected token cost? Need a clear CTA to pause/abort.

kevin: +1 on the UI. Also surface an estimated cost and expected latency impact per route. Ops needs to decide if we throttle to keep 95p latency under 250ms.

marta: Draft routing policy proposal:

```
{
  "policy": "replay-priority-v2",
  "max_concurrency": 48,
  "quota_bucket": "recompute_cohort_signals",
  "fallback": "replay-lowprio",
  "priority_by": "signal_score_percentile",
  "samples": 0.10
}
```

sam: LGTM. Add a circuit-breaker threshold: if error-rate on model endpoints > 1% for 5m, drain to lowprio.

raj: What about dedupe/ordering? If the original ingest was late and we recompute, we might double-count joins. We need idempotency keys per (user, window).

marta: Agreed — job will emit idempotency_key = sha256(user_id + window_start). Replay worker must upsert by idempotency_key.

kevin: For telemetry: tag all generated events with metadata: recompute_job_id, cohort_name, sample_flag. That lets dashboards filter out recompute noise.

lydia: UX checklist for the console:
- show job_id, created_by, target window
- live rate (events/s), progress %, ETA
- projected cost (tokens / $) and quota consumption remaining
- link to dry-run diff sample (CSV)
- abort + pause buttons with graceful drain

marta: We'll run a dry-run on staging with 5k users, compare aggregation diffs and push a sample CSV to S3 for the console diff view.

ops-bot: Scheduled job created: replay:cohort_signals:2376543210 (dry-run). Next run: 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z. Notifying #eng-oncall.

sam: On the infra side: ensure KV cache rehydrate is disabled for dry-run to avoid polluting cache. For prod run we want controlled warmups only for priority lanes.

raj: Backfill windowing question: do we shard by user hash to preserve ordering? We should also align shard boundaries with existing aggregate shards to minimize write hot spots.

marta: Yes — sharding by user_hash % 128 to match aggregate shards. We'll do staggered start times per shard to smooth IO.

kevin: Monitoring: create a temporary dashboard group:
- recompute:events_ingested/s
- recompute:agg_commit_latencies (p50/p95/p99)
- model:error_rate for endpoints touched
- total_tokens_consumed_by_recompute
Also add a regression alert: if aggregate diffs exceed 0.5% of baseline for >10m, fire to #eng-platform and #product-analytics.

lydia: For the console rollout UX, can we show a per-route expected degradation indicator (green/amber/red) based on projected concurrency? Product wants to decide pause windows.

sam: Implementation note: use the existing routing tag mechanism: request.metadata.replay_job_id and router will map to replay-priority-v2. That way no code changes to model infra.

raj: One more — ensure strong idempotency in the consumer: upsert path must be idempotent across retries and across multiple concurrent workers. We'll add a dedupe lease in the DB for 5m.

marta: Plan for rollout:
1) dry-run staging (5k users) — validate diffs + cost
2) small prod pilot (5% top-signal bucket) on replay-priority-v2 with 12 slots
3) expand to 40% then full cohort, with automated throttles

kevin: Schedule suggestion: pilot during NA overnight (02:00-06:00 local) to reduce user impact and to align with our quota refill windows. EU shards start 04:00Z.

lydia: UI followups: add a "show sample diff" modal that streams CSV rows and highlights changed aggregates. Also a small explainer about why recomputes are noisy.

sam: Ops note: put a temporary quota bucket limit of 500k tokens/hr for this job until we confirm cost profile. That will enforce backpressure if something goes wrong.

marta: I'll file the backfill job ticket with the above plan and attach the staging dry-run artifacts. Will tag everyone.

kevin: :thumbsup: Thanks. If possible, add a per-job toggle to suppress event telemetry that product analytics depends on, so we can run dry diffs without polluting production metrics.

marta: Good call — will add `suppress_analytics` flag for dry-run and for pilots.

ops-bot: Job replay:cohort_signals:2376543210 (dry-run) completed on staging. Summary: 5k users, 1.4M events processed, diff rate 0.18%, cost estimate for full run: ~2.1M tokens (~$420). Artifacts: s3://redwood-backfills/diffs/2376543210/sample.csv

raj: Nice. Can we schedule a 30m post-dry-run sync tomorrow to sign off?

marta: Yes — 2026-03-22 10:00 PT. Sending calendar invite.

kevin: Thanks all. Keeping the UI bits minimal for now is fine — main priority is safe routing and throttles.

marta: Closing loop here after the sync. Will update console tickets and enable pilot once we get green from product and eng-sre. :white_check_mark:
